* **Job Summary**
* Check\-in for multiple providers
* Must be organized and detail\-oriented
* Team player
* Must have excellent communication skills with a positive attitude
* Must be able to work from 7:30 am to 4:30 pm Monday \- Friday
* **Responsibilities Include**
* Verifying Insurance
* Scanning insurance cards
* collecting copays
* Assisting patients with check\-in process if needed
* Basic office skills filing, faxing, copying
* Maintain patient confidentiality by following HIPAA and compliance guidelines
* **Experience and Skills**
* Minimum of 1 year experience in a medical office
* Allscripts/ Phreesia knowledge is preferred but not required
* Insurance knowledge is preferred
* Ability to work independently and adapt to a fast\-paced environment
* Drug\-free workplace
* **Benefits**
* Health, Vision, Dental, 401K, PTO policy plus holidays
* **Benefit Conditions**
* Only full\-time employees are eligible
* a waiting period will apply
* **Work Remotely**
* No
* **Job Type**
* Full\-time
